## Install

Download **Mango-v0.10.0.apk** below and open it on your phone (allow installing unknown apps if Android asks). Android 8.0 or newer.

To update later, install the new APK over this one: your data stays.

**Coming from a test build (`app-debug.apk`)?** It was signed with a different key, so Android can't update it. Save a backup first (Options → Backup & restore → Save backup file), uninstall the old app, install this one, then choose *Restore a backup* on the welcome screen.

## What's in this version

- Max tests built into every program: front lever, pull-ups, dips, overhead press and push-ups at the end of each deload week, besides the max hang and weighted pull-up. The first week calibrates anything never tested.
- Loads, reps and holds follow your latest maxes from the day after a test; a "Your maxes" card shows your progress.
- Finger extensions added to the antagonist work; dumbbells / barbell are now separate from the weight belt in your equipment.
- Whole chicken: buy whole birds, break them down, turn the frame into stock, freeze the rest; a kitchen prep card guides you.
- Backup & restore to a file you choose, with auto-save.
- 163 recipes for one person, including French, Italian, Japanese, Chinese and Southeast Asian classics.
